//: LifeOps MCP server registration for Hermes.
Copy the `lifeops` entry into your Hermes MCP server configuration.
Client identity is declared per connection via --client, not per tool
call. A tool argument would be model-controlled, which would let an agent
name itself Hermes and inherit Hermes's capabilities (BUILD_SPEC 34).
No provider credential appears here. LifeOps needs only the NornicDB
connection, which scripts/nornicdb.sh generates into nornicdb.env; every
other provider is configured by the user in LifeOps Console.
